verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִמְשִׁיחוֹ֮ לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי בִֽימִינ֗וֹ לְרַד־ לְפָנָיו֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמָתְנֵ֥י מְלָכִ֖ים אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ לִפְתֹּ֤חַ לְפָנָיו֙ דְּלָתַ֔יִם וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh lim·šî·ḥōw lə·ḵō·w·reš ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî ḇî·mî·nōw lə·raḏ- lə·p̄ā·nāw gō·w·yim ū·mā·ṯə·nê mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·p̄at·tê·aḥ lip̄·tō·aḥ lə·p̄ā·nāw də·lā·ṯa·yim ū·šə·‘ā·rîm lō yis·sā·ḡê·rū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations . . . before him to disarm kings to open the doors before him so that the gates will not be shut

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲדוּרִ֖ים אוֹשִׁר דַּלְת֤וֹת נְחוּשָׁה֙ אֲשַׁבֵּ֔ר וּבְרִיחֵ֥י בַרְזֶ֖ל אֲגַדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’ê·lêḵ wa·hă·ḏū·rîm ʾō·šir dal·ṯō·wṯ nə·ḥū·šāh ’ă·šab·bêr ū·ḇə·rî·ḥê ḇar·zel ’ă·ḡad·dê·a‘
verses.literal: I will go before you and level the mountains I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ אוֹצְר֣וֹת חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וּמַטְמֻנֵ֖י מִסְתָּרִ֑ים לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הַקּוֹרֵ֥א בְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ ḥō·šeḵ ū·maṭ·mu·nê mis·tā·rîm lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏa‘ kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh haq·qō·w·rê ḇə·šim·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places so that you may know that I am the LORD the God of Israel who calls you by name

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ עַבְדִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּחִירִ֑י וָאֶקְרָ֤א לְךָ֙ בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ אֲכַנְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḥî·rî wā·’eq·rā lə·ḵā biš·me·ḵā ’ă·ḵan·nə·ḵā wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tā·nî
verses.literal: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one I call you by name I have given you a title of honor though you have not known Me

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ zū·lā·ṯî ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·’az·zer·ḵā wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tā·nî
verses.literal: I am the LORD and there is no other there is no God but Me I will equip you for battle though you have not known Me

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וּמִמַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔הּ כִּי־ אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḏə·‘ū mim·miz·raḥ- še·meš ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rā·ḇāh kî- ’e·p̄es bil·‘ā·ḏāy ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: so that all may know from where the sun rises . . . to where it sets that there is none but Me I am the LORD and there is no other

verses.original: יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹר֙ וּבוֹרֵ֣א חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם וּב֣וֹרֵא רָ֑ע אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ṣêr ’ō·wr ū·ḇō·w·rê ḥō·šeḵ ‘ō·śeh šā·lō·wm ū·ḇō·w·rê rā‘ ’ă·nî Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh ḵāl ’êl·leh
verses.literal: I form the light and create the darkness I bring prosperity and create calamity I the LORD do all these things

verses.original: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וּשְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ־ צֶ֑דֶק תִּפְתַּח־ אֶ֣רֶץ וְיִפְרוּ־ יֶ֗שַׁע וּצְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֙יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: har·‘î·p̄ū šā·ma·yim mim·ma·‘al ū·šə·ḥā·qîm yiz·zə·lū- ṣe·ḏeq tip̄·taḥ- ’e·reṣ wə·yip̄·rū- ye·ša‘ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ṯaṣ·mî·aḥ ya·ḥaḏ ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·rā·ṯîw
verses.literal: Drip down O heavens from above and let the skies pour down righteousness Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it I the LORD have created it

verses.original: ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת־ יֹ֣צְר֔וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת־ חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה הֲיֹאמַ֨ר חֹ֤מֶר לְיֹֽצְרוֹ֙ מַֽה־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּפָעָלְךָ֖ אֵין־ יָדַ֥יִם לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w rāḇ ’eṯ- yō·ṣə·rōw ḥe·reś ’eṯ- ḥar·śê ’ă·ḏā·māh hă·yō·mar ḥō·mer lə·yō·ṣə·rōw mah- ta·‘ă·śeh ū·p̄ā·‘ā·lə·ḵā ’ên- yā·ḏa·yim lōw
verses.literal: Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker one clay pot . . . among many . . . Does the clay ask the potter What are you making Does your work say He has no hands

verses.original: ה֛וֹי אֹמֵ֥ר לְאָ֖ב מַה־ תּוֹלִ֑יד וּלְאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־ תְּחִילִֽין׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’ō·mêr lə·’āḇ mah- tō·w·lîḏ ū·lə·’iš·šāh mah- tə·ḥî·lîn
verses.literal: Woe to him who says to his father What have you begotten or to his mother What have you brought forth

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיֹצְר֑וֹ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת שְׁאָל֔וּנִי עַל־ בָּנַ֛י וְעַל־ פֹּ֥עַל יָדַ֖י תְּצַוֻּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·yō·ṣə·rōw hā·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ šə·’ā·lū·nî ‘al- bā·nay wə·‘al- pō·‘al yā·ḏay tə·ṣaw·wu·nî
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the Holy One of Israel and its Maker Concerning things to come do you question Me about My sons or instruct Me in the work of My hands

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֖ם עָלֶ֣יהָ בָרָ֑אתִי אֲנִ֗י יָדַי֙ נָט֣וּ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְכָל־ צְבָאָ֖ם צִוֵּֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’e·reṣ wə·’ā·ḏām ‘ā·le·hā ḇā·rā·ṯî ’ă·nî yā·ḏay nā·ṭū šā·ma·yim wə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā·’ām ṣiw·wê·ṯî
verses.literal: It is I who made the earth and created . . . man upon it It was My hands that stretched out the heavens and I ordained all their host

verses.original: אָנֹכִי֙ הַעִירֹתִ֣הֽוּ בְצֶ֔דֶק וְכָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִי֙ וְגָלוּתִ֣י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִמְחִיר֙ וְלֹ֣א בְשֹׁ֔חַד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ha·‘î·rō·ṯi·hū ḇə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw ’ă·yaš·šêr hū- yiḇ·neh ‘î·rî wə·ḡā·lū·ṯî yə·šal·lê·aḥ lō ḇim·ḥîr wə·lō ḇə·šō·ḥaḏ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness and I will make all his ways straight He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free but not for payment or reward says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יְגִ֨יעַ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּֽסְחַר־ כּוּשׁ֮ וּסְבָאִים֮ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִדָּה֒ עָלַ֤יִךְ יַעֲבֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלָ֣ךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ אַחֲרַ֣יִךְ יֵלֵ֔כוּ בַּזִּקִּ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְאֵלַ֤יִךְ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ אַ֣ךְ בָּ֥ךְ אֵ֛ל וְאֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד אֶ֥פֶס אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh yə·ḡî·a‘ miṣ·ra·yim ū·sə·ḥar- kūš ū·sə·ḇā·’îm ’an·šê mid·dāh ‘ā·la·yiḵ ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū wə·lāḵ yih·yū ’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ yê·lê·ḵū baz·ziq·qîm ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū wə·’ê·la·yiḵ yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū ’ê·la·yiḵ yiṯ·pal·lā·lū ’aḵ bāḵ ’êl wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ ’e·p̄es ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush along with the Sabeans men of stature will come over to you and will be yours they will trudge behind you they will come over in chains and bow down to you They will confess to you God is indeed with you and there is no other there is no other God

verses.original: אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên ’at·tāh ’êl mis·tat·têr ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Truly You are a God who hides Himself O God of Israel the Savior

verses.original: בּ֥וֹשׁוּ וְגַֽם־ נִכְלְמ֖וּ כֻּלָּ֑ם יַחְדָּו֙ הָלְכ֣וּ בַכְּלִמָּ֔ה חָרָשֵׁ֖י צִירִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bō·wō·šū wə·ḡam- niḵ·lə·mū kul·lām yaḥ·dāw hā·lə·ḵū ḇak·kə·lim·māh ḥā·rā·šê ṣî·rîm
verses.literal: They will all be put to shame and humiliated the makers of idols will depart together in disgrace

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּיהוָ֔ה תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת עוֹלָמִ֑ים לֹא־ תֵבֹ֥שׁוּ וְלֹא־ תִכָּלְמ֖וּ עַד־ ע֥וֹלְמֵי עַֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl nō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh tə·šū·‘aṯ ‘ō·w·lā·mîm lō- ṯê·ḇō·šū wə·lō- ṯik·kā·lə·mū ‘aḏ- ‘ō·wl·mê ‘aḏ
verses.literal: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation you will not be put to shame . . . or humiliated to ages everlasting

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְ֠הוָה בּוֹרֵ֨א הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים יֹצֵ֨ר הָאָ֤רֶץ וְעֹשָׂהּ֙ ה֣וּא כֽוֹנְנָ֔הּ לֹא־ תֹ֥הוּ בְרָאָ֖הּ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת יְצָרָ֑הּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar- Yah·weh bō·w·rê haš·šā·ma·yim hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yō·ṣêr hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘ō·śāh hū ḵō·wn·nāh lō- ṯō·hū ḇə·rā·’āh lā·še·ḇeṯ yə·ṣā·rāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: For thus says the LORD who created the heavens He is God He formed the earth and fashioned it He established it He did not create it to be empty but formed it to be inhabited I am the LORD and there is no other

verses.original: לֹ֧א בַסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי בִּמְקוֹם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לֹ֥א אָמַ֛רְתִּי לְזֶ֥רַע יַעֲקֹ֖ב תֹּ֣הוּ בַקְּשׁ֑וּנִי אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר צֶ֔דֶק מַגִּ֖יד מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḇas·sê·ṯer dib·bar·tî bim·qō·wm ’e·reṣ ḥō·šeḵ lō ’ā·mar·tî lə·ze·ra‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ tō·hū ḇaq·qə·šū·nî ’ă·nî Yah·weh dō·ḇêr ṣe·ḏeq mag·gîḏ mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: I have not spoken in secret from a place in a land of darkness I did not say to the descendants of Jacob Seek Me in a wasteland I the LORD speak the truth I say what is right

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וָבֹ֛אוּ הִֽתְנַגְּשׁ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו פְּלִיטֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ הַנֹּֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣ץ פִּסְלָ֔ם וּמִתְפַּלְלִ֔ים אֶל־ אֵ֖ל לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū wā·ḇō·’ū hiṯ·nag·gə·šū yaḥ·dāw pə·lî·ṭê hag·gō·w·yim lō yā·ḏə·‘ū han·nō·śə·’îm ’eṯ- ‘êṣ pis·lām ū·miṯ·pal·lîm ’el- ’êl lō yō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Come gather together and draw near . . . you fugitives from the nations Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ וְהַגִּ֔ישׁוּ אַ֥ף יִֽוָּעֲצ֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ֣י הִשְׁמִיעַ֩ זֹ֨את מִקֶּ֜דֶם מֵאָ֣ז הִגִּידָ֗הּ הֲל֨וֹא אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵֽין־ ע֤וֹד אֱלֹהִים֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י אֵֽל־ צַדִּ֣יק וּמוֹשִׁ֔יעַ אַ֖יִן זוּלָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū wə·hag·gî·šū ’ap̄ yiw·wā·‘ă·ṣū yaḥ·dāw mî hiš·mî·a‘ zōṯ miq·qe·ḏem mê·’āz hig·gî·ḏāh hă·lō·w ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên- ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay ’êl- ṣad·dîq ū·mō·wō·šî·a‘ ’a·yin zū·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: Speak up and present your case yes let them take counsel together Who foretold this long ago Who announced it from ancient times Was it not I the LORD There is no other God but Me a righteous God and Savior there is none but Me

verses.original: פְּנוּ־ אֵלַ֥י וְהִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי־ אֵ֖ל וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nū- ’ê·lay wə·hiw·wā·šə·‘ū kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ kî ’ă·nî- ’êl wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Turn to Me and be saved all the ends of the earth for I am God and there is no other

verses.original: בִּ֣י נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי יָצָ֨א מִפִּ֧י צְדָקָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יָשׁ֑וּב כִּי־ לִי֙ תִּכְרַ֣ע כָּל־ בֶּ֔רֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַ֖ע כָּל־ לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bî niš·ba‘·tî yā·ṣā mip·pî ṣə·ḏā·qāh dā·ḇār wə·lō yā·šūḇ kî- lî tiḵ·ra‘ kāl- be·reḵ tiš·šā·ḇa‘ kāl- lā·šō·wn
verses.literal: By Myself I have sworn truth has gone out from My mouth a word that will not be revoked . . . Every knee will bow before Me every tongue will swear allegiance

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ בַּיהוָ֛ה לִ֥י אָמַ֖ר צְדָק֣וֹת וָעֹ֑ז עָדָיו֙ יָב֣וֹא וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ Yah·weh lî ’ā·mar ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ wā·‘ōz ‘ā·ḏāw yā·ḇō·w wə·yê·ḇō·šū kōl han·ne·ḥĕ·rîm bōw
verses.literal: Surely they will say of Me In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame

verses.original: בַּיהוָ֛ה יִצְדְּק֥וּ וְיִֽתְהַלְל֖וּ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiṣ·də·qū wə·yiṯ·hal·lū kāl- ze·ra‘ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult
